text: dsh-model-router-lite 是一款为 DSH 原生子 agent 提供按任务选择模型偏好的插件。它把策略提示加入 system prompt，并仅在当前范围支持原生 provider/model 选择时显示。用户可以分别为 routine、complex 和 review 任务设置已授权的 provider 与 model；未配置的类别沿用父 agent 模型。插件不会自行授予模型权限，适合希望按任务类型安排子 agent 模型、同时保留 DSH 原生授权边界的用户。

dsh-model-router-lite guides native DSH subagents to use authorized model preferences for routine, complex, and review tasks. Unconfigured tasks inherit the parent model. Guidance appears only when native model selection is supported; the plugin grants no permissions.
想按日常、复杂和审查任务给 DSH 子 agent 选不同模型。
Can I set model preferences for fresh subagents by task category while keeping DSH authorization in control?
dsh-model-router-lite 的功能「按任务偏好路由」：在配置中为 routine、complex、review 指定已授权的 provider 和 model。策略提示指导父 agent 按类别选择；未配置的类别继承父模型。
dsh-model-router-lite 的功能「按原生能力显示建议」：插件把路由说明加入 system prompt；仅当当前工具范围支持子 agent 的 provider/model 参数及模型目录查询时显示，其他范围不显示。

**Task-based model preferences for native DSH subagents.**

After setup, the parent agent is guided to choose an authorized model for each fresh subagent task. No extra routing-model call, scheduler, or dashboard.
section: Model Router Lite · 轻量模型路由

text:
dsh-model-router-lite README · What changes?：| Without this plugin's policy | With model permission and preferences configured |
| --- | --- |
| A subagent normally inherits the parent/default model when no route is specified. DSH already supports explicit model selection. | Routine tasks, complex work, and independent reviews receive your chosen model preferences. |
| You give model-selection instructions yourself. | The parent gets a short, reusable policy and checks the native allowed-model catalog before explicitly routing. |
| The main conversation keeps its selected model. | Still unchanged. Only fresh `subagent` calls are covered. |

dsh-model-router-lite README · What changes?：```text
Task → parent agent classifies it
       ├─ routine → your routine model preference
       ├─ complex → your complex model preference
       └─ review  → your review model preference

**This is advisory prompt guidance, not enforced routing.** It does not benchmark models or guarantee lower cost, greater speed, or better answers. Explicit user choices take priority when authorized; an unavailable explicit choice must be reported, not silently replaced.

dsh-model-router-lite README · Install：Requires DSH **0.2.1-rc.5** or compatible 0.2.x stable releases. Use your active profile's plugin manager to install the [public npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-model-router-lite):

```text
dsh-model-router-lite@0.1.0
```

For a CLI-managed installation:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add dsh-model-router-lite@0.1.0
```

dsh-model-router-lite README · Install：Alternatively, install the [prebuilt GitHub release archive](https://github.com/WangZW928/dsh-model-router-lite/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-model-router-lite-0.1.0.tgz). Replace `YOUR_PROFILE` with the actual profile. Desktop users should install through the app, not assume their profile is `web`. No build or install scripts are shipped.

dsh-model-router-lite README · Install：Public npm/GitHub availability is separate from catalog acceptance and index synchronization. Track the [market submission](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/11758) for its current review status.
dsh-model-router-lite README · Set up once：**Installing alone does not select different models.** Public defaults contain no model IDs and grant no permissions.

dsh-model-router-lite README · Set up once：1. Configure providers/models in DSH. In the native Subagent model-selection settings, explicitly authorize the routes you want to use. Cross-provider tasks send their child-task context to the chosen provider.
2. Set this plugin's `routes` in its native plugin configuration. Use exact `provider` and `model` IDs from DSH, not display names. Each category accepts at most one preference; omitted categories inherit the parent model.
3. Start a **new top-level conversation** with Standard, PTC, or Cordis. Existing conversations keep their recorded permission snapshot.

dsh-model-router-lite README · Set up once：Example plugin config — replace these placeholders with authorized IDs:

```yaml
enabled: true
routes:
  - task: routine
    provider: YOUR_PROVIDER_ID

- `routine`: bounded lookup, extraction, summaries, mechanical edits.
- `complex`: implementation, architecture, hard debugging, uncertain or high-risk work.
- `review`: independent review of ordinary-risk work; high-risk review belongs to `complex`.

dsh-model-router-lite README · Set up once：Ask normally: **“Split the independent research and implementation work into subagents where useful. Briefly explain each model choice.”** The agent need not delegate when it can finish the task directly.

dsh-model-router-lite README · Boundaries：- Uses native `list_subagent_models` lazily and native `subagent` parameters; it creates no tools, background jobs, telemetry, or network calls of its own.
- Shows guidance only in scopes exposing native model-selection arguments and the discovery tool. No fork, Team, Workflow, main-model, or Minimal-preset routing.
- Unavailable/incompatible default preferences fall back to the parent route. Partially executed work must be reconciled before retrying.
- Profile-wide Host plugin, not workspace-only. Disabling the plugin removes guidance; it does not revoke permissions you granted in DSH or rewrite existing session snapshots.
- No automatic authorization, provider discovery expansion, credential access, or hard security boundary. No promise that the parent always follows the policy.

dsh-model-router-lite README · Validation and development：Policy/schema/resource tests cover scope gating, exact IDs, duplicate rules, fallback instructions, safe defaults, and package contents. The original local implementation activated on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5; unit tests do **not** establish live provider connectivity, comparative quality, or real cross-model execution. Rendered GUI metadata and a full live cross-provider run remain unverified.

```sh
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm check
pnpm test
pnpm pack
